in_marathi.name: Mandooka
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Fish, Vehicle of Lord Vishnu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mandooka हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mandooka is a Sanskrit name that means 'fish'. In Hindu mythology, Mandooka is the vehicle of Lord Vishnu. The name is derived from the Mandar fish, which is considered sacred in Hinduism and symbolizes prosperity, good fortune, and protection.
